releaseNotes:
• Advanced OCR & Document Intelligence: High-accuracy Google ML Kit on-device text recognition with multi-pass enhancement
• Smart Country & Format Detection: Automatic recognition of Kuwait (+965), Nepal (+977), India (+91), UAE (+971), and international numbers with country flags
• Intelligent Duplicate Consolidation: Merges duplicate numbers automatically and filters out junk dates, times, and currencies
• Interactive Image Enhancement Studio: Live contrast/brightness tuning, 90° rotation, unsharp-mask sharpening, noise reduction, and binarization
• Extracted Entity Fields: Automatically identifies Organization/Business, Contact Person, Phone, Email, Website, and Physical Address
• Multi-Page Batch Scanning: Scan multiple pages with thumbnail strip, review consolidated contacts, and export to vCard (.vcf) & Spreadsheet (.csv)
• Inline Result Editor: Directly edit or refine recognized caller info, numbers, and categories
• Crash & Security Hardening: Fixed READ_PHONE_STATE runtime permission checks on cold start preventing SecurityException
